Gain direct hands-on experience through structured lab simulations and practical exercises.
Apply best practices for configuration, security hardening, troubleshooting, and optimization.
Prepare thoroughly for official industry certification exams aligned with CompTIA standards.
prerequisites: Basic foundational knowledge of IT systems and networking principles.
Prior experience or prerequisite coursework in Infrastructure is recommended.
